_comment: Ablation function signature library v1. Behavioral descriptions used for semantic matching against stripped binaries.

signatures.name: memcpy
signatures.description: copies a fixed number of bytes from a source address to a destination address with no bounds checking on the destination buffer

signatures.name: memmove
signatures.description: copies bytes between potentially overlapping memory regions; handles overlap by copying through a temporary buffer

signatures.name: memset
signatures.description: fills a block of memory with a single repeated byte value; commonly used to zero-initialize buffers before use

signatures.name: memcmp
signatures.description: compares two memory regions byte-by-byte and returns zero if equal; timing is proportional to common prefix length

signatures.name: strlen
signatures.description: iterates through a null-terminated string counting bytes until it finds the zero terminator; no maximum length bound

signatures.name: strcpy
signatures.description: copies a null-terminated string to a destination buffer without checking whether the destination is large enough

signatures.name: strncpy
signatures.description: copies at most n bytes from source string to destination; pads with null bytes if source is shorter than n

signatures.name: strcat
signatures.description: appends a null-terminated string to another by finding the null terminator and copying; no bounds check on destination

signatures.name: strcmp
signatures.description: compares two null-terminated strings character by character; returns zero if identical, negative or positive otherwise

signatures.name: strncmp
signatures.description: compares up to n characters of two null-terminated strings; returns zero if the first n bytes are identical

signatures.name: sprintf
signatures.description: formats a string with printf-style format specifiers and writes the result to a caller-supplied buffer with no length limit

signatures.name: snprintf
signatures.description: formats a string with printf-style format specifiers and writes at most n bytes including the null terminator to a caller-supplied buffer

signatures.name: sscanf
signatures.description: parses formatted input from a string according to a format string and writes converted values into caller-supplied pointers

signatures.name: strtol
signatures.description: converts a string representation of a number to an integer; sets an end pointer to the first unconverted character

signatures.name: malloc
signatures.description: allocates a requested number of bytes from the heap and returns a pointer; returns NULL on allocation failure

signatures.name: calloc
signatures.description: allocates memory for an array of elements and initializes all bytes to zero; multiplies count by size

signatures.name: realloc
signatures.description: resizes a previously allocated heap block; copies existing contents to the new block if relocation is needed

signatures.name: free
signatures.description: releases a heap block back to the allocator; calling with an already-freed pointer causes undefined behavior

signatures.name: recv
signatures.description: reads bytes from a network socket into a caller-supplied buffer; returns the number of bytes actually received

signatures.name: send
signatures.description: writes bytes from a buffer to a network socket; may block if the socket send buffer is full

signatures.name: accept
signatures.description: accepts an incoming TCP connection on a listening socket and returns a new connected socket file descriptor

signatures.name: connect
signatures.description: initiates a TCP connection to a remote address; blocks until connected or until the connection times out

signatures.name: getenv
signatures.description: looks up the value of an environment variable by name and returns a pointer into the process environment block

signatures.name: system
signatures.description: executes a shell command string by passing it to /bin/sh; command injection is possible if any part comes from untrusted input

signatures.name: execve
signatures.description: replaces the current process image with a new program; the argv array and environment are passed to the new program

signatures.name: fopen
signatures.description: opens a file at a given path with a specified mode string and returns a FILE handle or file descriptor

signatures.name: fread
signatures.description: reads a specified number of fixed-size records from a file into a caller-supplied buffer

signatures.name: fwrite
signatures.description: writes a specified number of fixed-size records from a buffer to a file

signatures.name: SSL_read
signatures.description: reads decrypted application data from a TLS session into a caller-supplied buffer; handles TLS record reassembly internally

signatures.name: SSL_write
signatures.description: encrypts application data and writes it to the underlying socket as one or more TLS records

signatures.name: SSL_connect
signatures.description: performs the TLS client handshake; negotiates cipher suite, verifies server certificate, and establishes session keys

signatures.name: EVP_EncryptUpdate
signatures.description: encrypts a buffer using a symmetric cipher in a streaming context; updates the internal cipher state for multi-block inputs

signatures.name: SHA256_Update
signatures.description: feeds a chunk of data into an incremental hash computation; accumulates input before the final digest is computed

signatures.name: RAND_bytes
signatures.description: fills a buffer with cryptographically strong random bytes from the platform entropy source

signatures.name: printf
signatures.description: formats and prints output according to a format string; unsafe if the format string originates from untrusted input

signatures.name: json_parse
signatures.description: parses a JSON string into an in-memory tree of typed nodes; allocates memory proportional to input depth

signatures.name: xml_parse
signatures.description: parses an XML document byte stream; dispatches callbacks or builds a DOM tree for each element encountered

signatures.name: base64_decode
signatures.description: decodes a base64-encoded string into raw bytes; output buffer must be at least 3/4 the input length

signatures.name: url_decode
signatures.description: decodes percent-encoded URL sequences by replacing %XX escape codes with the corresponding byte values

signatures.name: pthread_mutex_lock
signatures.description: acquires an exclusive mutex lock; blocks the calling thread until the lock is available
